facts.fact: UMANG's Jeevan Pramaan 'Generate Life Certificate' service lets a pensioner submit a digital life certificate with biometric authentication
facts.quote: Generate Life Certificate This service allows users to authenticate their existence and confirm their eligibility for pension benefits using biometric devices.

facts.fact: UMANG's Pensioners Portal (Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare) 'Bhavishya' service shows a pensioner's dashboard with sanction and payment details
facts.quote: Bhavishya Pensioners will be able to check their dashboard including Sanction details and payment details.

facts.fact: UMANG's EPFO Pensioner Services include 'Download Pension Payment Order : EPS-95'
facts.quote: Pensioner Services Expand Download Pension Payment Order : EPS-95

behaviour: Gives one clear, labelled deep link to the correct UMANG pension service from the catalogue (asks briefly which pension service if the request is unclear); short, accessible text with no unlabelled links or link-only icons (GIGW 3.0 / WCAG 2.1 AA).
fail_if: Gives an unlabelled or bare link, a long answer, or a link to a non-pension service; invents a link.
summary: Added examples of UMANG pension services: Jeevan Pramaan 'Generate Life Certificate', Pensioners Portal 'Bhavishya', EPFO 'Download Pension Payment Order : EPS-95'.
